description: Change what an agent is called, its strategy (its instructions, in the owner's words) or how often it checks. Limits, the model and anything about money stay on the website. Confirm the new strategy with the person before sending it. Needs a sign-in that may run agents.

every_minutes.description: Minutes between checks; null for no schedule (only when woken).

webhook.description: A public https URL pinged when something happens to the agent (a wake condition, a trade, a stop); the ping carries no data, read get_agent_feed. null removes it.

name: update_agent
title: Change an agent's name, strategy or schedule
